name: operai
description: Operai — wellD's AI-assisted consulting toolsuite (EstimAI + refund + admin + notify). This root holds the umbrella version + Changesets release tooling ONLY; each app (auth/estimai-api/notify-api/refund-api/shell/estimai-ui/refund-ui/notify-ui/admin-ui) is versioned independently and installed/built on its own (frontends via pnpm, backends via Bun). The `workspaces` field below is npm-style ON PURPOSE: pnpm ignores it (pnpm needs pnpm-workspace.yaml), so per-app installs and the per-app Vercel/Railway deploys are unchanged — it exists only so Changesets can enumerate the packages.
